keySentence: Mary found a hidden secret garden behind the old wall.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: The garden was locked for ten years. Mary found the hidden key. She kept it a secret. Mary found a hidden secret garden behind the old wall.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Mary learned the sad story behind the locked garden door. Her uncle's wife had loved this garden more than anything. After she died, the uncle locked the garden and hid the key. Mary found a hidden secret garden behind the old wall years later. She decided to keep it as her own special secret. She would bring the garden back to life all by herself.
